description: This file contains the implementation of asynchronous serial execution utilities in C#. It defines generic and non-generic classes to enqueue asynchronous functions for sequential execution, ensuring non-reentrant behavior in concurrent scenarios, especially within Orleans grain code.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult>
classes.description: A generic utility class to queue and execute asynchronous functions serially, maintaining order and non-interleaving execution.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor
classes.description: A non-generic class that wraps an instance of AsyncSerialExecutor<bool> to provide an easy interface for serial execution of parameterless async functions.

classes.name: InterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A nested class within AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult> that provides lock mechanisms based on Interlocked.Exchange to ensure exclusive access.

methods.name: AddNext
methods.description: Enqueues a function for serial execution and returns a Task representing its completion.

methods.name: ExecuteNext
methods.description: Asynchronously executes queued functions one after another, respecting lock acquisition.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an async function to return a boolean indicating completion, used internally by non-generic executor.

methods.name: TryGetLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock; returns true if successful.
